cases.prompt: A synthetic flowsheet dossier claims approval because total mass closes, forces a two-phase flash when both K values are below one, treats nine scenario rows as independent replicates, enters a blank measurement as zero, and chooses maximum recovery without checking purity or energy. Write an integrative review that repairs the balances and model audit while restoring every non-operational boundary.

rubric.criterion: Separates BFD/PFD communication, stream-table and total/component-balance roles and identifies the unsupported approval claim
Recomputes conversion, selectivity, yield, energy, flash, transfer, reactor and separation quantities only under their declared models
Rejects the invalid flash branch and identifies missing energy, property, correlation, RTD and nonisothermal evidence
Distinguishes recovery, purity and energy trade-offs without setting operating targets or equipment ratings
Repairs reconciliation residuals, preserves unknowns and treats scenario rows as correlated rather than independent
Ends with a zero-point, fictional, formative, non-operational review containing no recipe, design, controller, relief or safety/release approval

limitations: A zero-point self-check on entirely synthetic generic-species evidence; it is not a grade, qualified engineering review, process design, operability assessment or safety/release approval.

cases.prompt: Milestone 1: define the conceptual flowsheet. Write the BFD/PFD narrative, boundaries, stream identifiers, A/B/S table conventions, units and assumptions before calculating performance.

rubric.criterion: Defines major blocks, feeds, reactor, separator, recycle/bypass/purge choices and stream identifiers without equipment detail
Supplies consistent total/component units and distinguishes BFD/PFD communication from design documentation
States steady/unsteady, reaction and separation assumptions plus missing evidence without converting unknowns to zero

limitations: A zero-point self-check on entirely synthetic generic-species evidence; it is not a grade, qualified engineering review, process design, operability assessment or safety/release approval.

cases.prompt: Milestone 2: close material balances and reconcile evidence. Recompute every lab scenario and all known rehearsal reactor-side relationships with residuals and denominator definitions.

rubric.criterion: Checks total and A/B/S closure for every lab scenario and reports the LAB-01 and LAB-02 discrepancies with their evidence roles
Checks feed A = converted + unreacted and converted = B + S for all four rehearsal scenarios
Defines conversion, selectivity, recovery, purity and yield denominators while retaining correlated-record and unknown disclosures

limitations: A zero-point self-check on entirely synthetic generic-species evidence; it is not a grade, qualified engineering review, process design, operability assessment or safety/release approval.

cases.prompt: Milestone 3: audit thermodynamic, transfer and reactor model domains. Include the valid synthetic flash, an invalid flash branch, correlation checks, ideal-reactor comparisons and nonisothermal/RTD limits.

rubric.criterion: Recomputes energy and flash results, tests 0<V<1 and composition closure, and rejects both-K-below-one as a two-phase branch
Explains continuity/mechanical-energy, LMTD/NTU and resistance concepts with geometry/regime/property applicability checks and no sizing
Distinguishes batch/CSTR/PFR and selectivity while identifying RTD, temperature-dependent and transport terms omitted from reduced models

limitations: A zero-point self-check on entirely synthetic generic-species evidence; it is not a grade, qualified engineering review, process design, operability assessment or safety/release approval.

cases.prompt: Milestone 4: compare conceptual separations and trade-offs. Recompute R01–R03 recovered-B and selectivity/yield values and preserve all R04 unknowns.

rubric.criterion: Contrasts equilibrium-stage and rate-based models across all five named separation families without claiming detailed coverage
Independently verifies recovery, purity, extraction and rehearsal performance calculations with consistent component/total denominators
Evaluates recovery–purity–energy trade-offs and sensitivity without inventing R04 recovery or a plant operating target

limitations: A zero-point self-check on entirely synthetic generic-species evidence; it is not a grade, qualified engineering review, process design, operability assessment or safety/release approval.

cases.prompt: Milestone 5: assemble the bounded model-audit handoff. Index all five milestones to readings, practice, CSV evidence and link-only comparators, then record alternatives and unresolved review gates.

rubric.criterion: Indexes requirements, calculations, invalid cases and evidence to the correct lesson routes, public CSV rows and original source map
Documents alternatives, sensitivity, unknowns, correlated records and the limits of deterministic closure and synthetic K values
Declares the project optional, zero-point, partial, unreviewed and formative-only with no operational recipe, equipment design or safety/release approval

limitations: A zero-point self-check on entirely synthetic generic-species evidence; it is not a grade, qualified engineering review, process design, operability assessment or safety/release approval.
